newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice ends unchanged on paper-thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice ends unchanged on paper-thin volume.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures ended unchanged in slow trading on Friday with most investors staying on the sidelines, traders said.
The only traded October contract ended at 1,900 yuan ($228) per tonne, unchanged from Thursday's close. It opened at 1,900 and did not move for the whole session.
Combined volume fell to 400 tonnes from 3,000.
Traders said investors continued to move their money from the rice market, resulting in slow trading.
"Investors have lost interest in rice trading due to a lack of market-moving news," a trader said.
Traders expect rice to continue to trade on thin volume in the short term.
